direct-comparison.def: For series with $0 \le a_n \le b_n$: if $\sum b_n$ converges, so does $\sum a_n$; if $\sum a_n$ diverges, so does $\sum b_n$.

limit-comparison.def: For series with positive terms: if $\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{a_n}{b_n}$ is a finite positive number, then $\sum a_n$ and $\sum b_n$ both converge or both diverge.
